title: Wild: From Lost to Found on the Pacific Crest Trail
author: Cheryl Strayed
summary: After her mother's death and the end of her marriage, Cheryl Strayed sets out alone to hike the Pacific Crest Trail with almost no experience. The long walk becomes a way of facing grief and her own mistakes.
readIf: you want an honest, emotional story of grief and self-rebuilding told through a hard hike.
skipIf: you are mainly after trail detail or an upbeat outdoors adventure.
